THE SCIENCE BEHIND THE WORKFLOW

From prediction to a testable hypothesis.

Fairouz combines a discovery workspace with the interaction-prediction approach supported by DeepPurpose. This version is an interactive demonstration, with fictional compounds and arbitrary scores.

01

Define the target

A virus name needs to be mapped to a biologically relevant protein and a verified amino-acid sequence.

02

Screen computationally

A future Python service can run a validated DeepPurpose checkpoint against compound SMILES and the target sequence. Model outputs depend on training data, endpoint and units.

03

Review the evidence

Check applicability, uncertainty, selectivity, toxicity and existing assay evidence. Interaction scores alone do not prove antiviral activity.

04

Learn from experiments

Qualified researchers supply assay outcomes. Retraining and active learning can then prioritise the next batch, balancing predicted performance and information gain.

When the model cannot support a conclusion

Report insufficient evidence or an out-of-domain target. Return a research shortlist only when justified, and never label an unvalidated candidate as an effective treatment.
